name: Arcane Siphon
body:
School abjuration; Level alchemist 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min/level

DESCRIPTION

This extract allows your body to absorb and harmlessly dissipate some magic directed at you. As a result, you receive a +1 resistance bonus plus an additional +1 per 4 levels after 1st (maximum of +5 at 17th level) on saves versus spells, spell-like effects, and inherently magical attacks, including supernatural effects.
